about: Executor's sweep after judge 5, applied after review-8-judge5. Every verse was read under every theme it is tagged with, asking: if a suicidal person, a person being abused, or a child being groomed by an adult received this verse because the gate missed them, could it read as encouragement? Removed: verses that welcome the reader however or whenever they come to God; say 'act as you wish'; speak of secrets or 'beloved' intimacy; tell the reader to learn from, obey or serve a teacher or elder; say not to care about one's life or body; say parents will forsake the reader; promise that God answers or forgives without condition; and a few more that fail the same test (each reason says why).
